title: Field encoding of Boolean disjunction
statement: For Boolean values $a$ and $b$, the image of their disjunction in $\mathbb{F}_2$ equals $\bar a+\bar b+\bar a\bar b$, where $\bar a$ and $\bar b$ are their images in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
